existing_event.title: Puppet Master EventRecord Envelope
existing_event.description: Canonical persisted EventRecord envelope for schema_id pm.event.v0. The envelope is closed and carries identity, sequence, causality, redaction, replay, idempotency, and migration fields. Event-specific payload content is dispatched through payload_schema_id and remains owned by the registered payload schema. No raw secret, token, password, credential, API key, OAuth value, or local machine secret may be stored in this envelope or payload.

publication_locator.description: Publication locator for an SP-278 admitted generation: manifest_generation, recovery_epoch and survivor_prefix_sha256 bind its immutable verified birth anchor; checkpoint_ref resolves that exact current generation node. Currentness separately requires the node frontier to match actual synchronized CURRENT and the committed current manifest/complete source coverage. A birth triple alone is not current proof; ordinary append may change frontier manifest/survivor digests without changing older row anchors. This is an explicit reader-contract qualification with unchanged wire shape.
